title.en: How well do you know us?

blurb.en: Three questions about the two people who dragged you all the way to Provence.
blurb.fr: Trois questions sur les deux personnes qui vous ont traînés jusqu’en Provence.
blurb.ko: 여러분을 프로방스까지 오게 만든 두 사람에 대한 세 문제.

prompt.en: Where did we meet for the very first time?
prompt.fr: Où nous sommes-nous rencontrés pour la toute première fois ?

text.fr: Dans la file d’attente d’un café

prompt.en: Which of these has one of us genuinely done?
prompt.fr: Laquelle de ces choses l’un de nous a-t-il vraiment faite ?
prompt.ko: 다음 중 우리 둘 중 한 명이 실제로 한 일은?

text.en: Missed a flight while asleep at the gate
text.fr: Raté un vol en dormant à la porte d’embarquement

prompt.en: In which city did we say yes to each other?
prompt.fr: Dans quelle ville nous sommes-nous dit oui ?

blurb.en: You have been here two days. Were you paying attention?
blurb.fr: Vous êtes là depuis deux jours. Étiez-vous attentifs ?
blurb.ko: 이틀째 여기 계셨죠. 잘 보고 계셨나요?

prompt.en: Which village are we in this weekend?
prompt.fr: Dans quel village sommes-nous ce week-end ?

prompt.en: What is the famous wind that blows through Provence?
prompt.fr: Quel est le vent célèbre qui souffle en Provence ?

blurb.en: No right answers here — just the ones that make us laugh hardest.
blurb.fr: Pas de bonne réponse ici — seulement celles qui nous feront le plus rire.
blurb.ko: 정답은 없어요 — 우리를 가장 웃게 하는 답이 이깁니다.

prompt.en: Give us one piece of marriage advice. Best one wins the points.
prompt.fr: Donnez-nous un conseil de mariage. Le meilleur remporte les points.
prompt.ko: 결혼 생활 조언을 하나 남겨 주세요. 가장 좋은 답이 점수를 가져갑니다.

questions.note: 3 points for anything that makes us both laugh, 1 for a sweet one, 0 for 'happy wife happy life'

prompt.en: What will we argue about first on the honeymoon?
prompt.fr: À propos de quoi allons-nous nous disputer en premier pendant la lune de miel ?
prompt.ko: 신혼여행에서 우리가 가장 먼저 다툴 일은 무엇일까요?

questions.note: Full points for anything about directions or packing

prompt.en: Name a song we absolutely have to play tonight.
prompt.fr: Citez une chanson qu’il faut absolument passer ce soir.
prompt.ko: 오늘 밤 꼭 틀어야 할 노래 하나를 적어 주세요.

questions.note: 2 points if it is already on the playlist, 1 if we add it on the spot
